pack.name: Agent Pulse
pack.tagline: The expressive states an AI product IS, not the buttons it has.

tokens.meaning: the agent is involved; no orb means the sound or signal itself
who acts: waves leaving the orb = emitting, waves arriving = receiving
intensity: 1-2 elements quiet, 3 or more loud
above the orb = needs human attention; sides = communication; corners = burst energy; front overlay = policy
off or muted, and nothing else
Ignition Orange only ever means active or hot; never decoration

claims.notes: no other icon may ship a bare orb

claims.zone: typing ellipsis dots on the orb
orbital arc segment around the orb
single dot hovering above the orb
exclamation on the orb + glitch offsets
shield in front of the orb
two orbs with a payload traveling an arc

keylines.note: Optical parity per Material keyline logic (docs/si-v2/research-icon-fundamentals-2026-07-14.md): different shapes draw at different dimensions to read as the same size.
keylines.compositions: total extent calibrated to the same optical weight: round compositions max span 19-21, boxy compositions 17-19; never fill the grid by default

palette.accent_rule: accent only ever means active or hot

layered_render.tile: rx 21, gTile vertical gradient, gRim top rim light
layered_render.orb: gOrb radial (38%/30% light origin) + gGlass specular cap upper-left

timing_law.ambient_rest: every loop carries a 2-5s rest or a rest beat inside the cycle
timing_law.reduced_motion: static first frame must read complete on its own

motion_language.render_scaling: detail scales down in static renders and up in animated ones; motion carries meaning static geometry must otherwise spell out

craft_rules.rule: One idea per icon, at most one secondary element.
Secondary elements draw lighter than the subject (1.8 vs 2 at 24 grid).
Sound is wave language (curves), never ray language (straight ticks).
Symmetric outward arcs around the orb belong exclusively to speaking; anything else wrapping the orb risks wheel/drone reads.
When a side element feels heavy, split it into segments rather than shrinking or doubling it.
Run the anti-association check before drawing: name what the shape must never read as.
craft_rules.origin: rounds 1-2 (sun, wheel, drone all preventable on paper)

craft_rules.rule: Keep at least 0.5 optical clearance between distinct elements; 1.5 canvas safety margin.
Decoration that tells a story the purpose does not need gets cut.
Metaphor approval on paper precedes geometry; geometry precedes rendering.

In a shared-silhouette family (the orb states), the interior mark is the whole signal: differentiate siblings through strong positive/negative contrast that survives 16px, never through subtle stroke variation.
craft_rules.origin: six-source research 2026-07-14 (silhouette monotony risk; Dribbble small-size testing; Hugeicons detail rule)

craft_rules.rule: Orb interiors stay rounded and friendly by default; sharp angular interior marks are reserved for negative states (error, blocked), where sharp reads as danger and reinforces meaning.

Full-frame subjects follow the keyline table (circle 20, square 18, rect 20x16); compositions calibrate total extent to equal optical weight instead of filling the grid. Never distort a keyline shape; reduce stroke toward 1.5 when space is tight.
